tuberization_network.transport_switch: At tuber onset, carbon unloading shifts from a predominantly apoplastic mode in elongating stolons toward symplastic unloading in the developing tuber.
tuberization_network.StSP6A_sugar_link: StSP6A can interact with StSWEET11-family transport activity, suppressing sucrose efflux to the apoplast and favoring symplastic allocation into tuber sink tissue.
tuberization_network.chromatin_context: Histone regulators including Polycomb-associated factors have been implicated in potato tuberization gene regulation.
tuberization_network.modern_extension: Recent reviews integrate epigenetic, epitranscriptomic, metabolic and mechanoperception/rhizosphere inputs into the classical photoperiod model.

hormone_logic.gibberellin: Generally promotes elongation and tends to antagonize tuber initiation/expansion when elevated in stolon contexts.
hormone_logic.cytokinin: Participates in cell division, bud/sprout regulation and tuber development; effects depend on stage and concentration.
hormone_logic.auxin: Supports tuber initiation/growth and interacts with gibberellin and strigolactone pathways.
hormone_logic.ABA: Important in dormancy/stress networks and interacts with other hormones rather than acting alone.
hormone_logic.ethylene: Influences sprouting, stress and storage physiology; effect is context- and treatment-dependent.
hormone_logic.strigolactone: Participates in branching and below-ground developmental signalling, including crosstalk relevant to tuberization.
hormone_logic.JA_SA: Important defense/stress signals that also cross-talk with growth and source-sink programs.

dormancy_and_sprouting.redox: Controlled ROS accumulation, including hydrogen peroxide signalling, participates in dormancy release/sprouting, balanced by antioxidant systems such as SOD and catalase.
dormancy_and_sprouting.key_rule: Dormancy termination is a systems transition, not a single-molecule timer.

starch_network.cold_storage: Cold can increase starch-to-sugar conversion; vacuolar invertase strongly contributes to glucose/fructose accumulation in cold-induced sweetening.
starch_network.quality_link: Starch composition and reducing-sugar accumulation affect texture, processing color and acrylamide precursor chemistry.
